source: captaincy_odds (fpl-research MCP), neutral+chase+protect modes, with_intel=True, shrunk=True

candidates.name: Gabriel
candidates.rationale: Top expected points in the squad by a clear margin, and the second-lowest blank risk behind only Raya (17.8% vs 20.2%) — a rare combination of ceiling and floor. Arsenal's attack is in form and he adds set-piece/clean-sheet threat on top of goal involvement, so the away trip to a wounded Aston Villa (4-0 GW1 defeat, defensive changes still bedding in) doesn't undermine the case the way a tough away fixture normally would for a defender.

candidates.name: João Pedro
candidates.rationale: Highest haul probability in the squad (10.0%, P(haul>=10)) and the best ceiling among the forwards — confirmed first-choice #9 with a home fixture. The trade-off is ownership: at 66.8% owned, captaining him is close to rank-neutral if he hauls, since most of the league already has the same shirt on. The safer pick if you want upside without a differential bet.

candidates.name: Thiago
candidates.rationale: Best differential score in the squad (DiffUp 7.2, highest P(haul) x (1-ownership) of anyone considered) at only 16.9% owned — a genuine rank-moving bet away at Leeds rather than a safe, crowded pick. Lower E[pts] and a higher blank risk than Gabriel or João Pedro, so this is the pick for chasing rank, not protecting it.

also_considered.name: Calvert-Lewin
also_considered.note: DiffUp 6.2, close behind Thiago, but lower E[pts] (3.98) and SUSP flag (1/5 toward a booking-related risk window)

also_considered.name: Raya
also_considered.note: Lowest P(blank) of anyone (20.2%) but caps out low on E[pts] (5.16) and DiffUp (0.1) — pure floor, no case for the armband over Gabriel

caveats: Point-in-time snapshot, not live-refreshed by this build script — refresh by re-running captaincy_odds via the fpl-research MCP (neutral/chase/protect) and rewriting this file, same pattern as entry_summary.json.

A name-matching issue was found when Sarr (Crystal Palace, this squad) was queried: captaincy_odds matched a different player (M.Sarr, Chelsea) instead. Sarr was excluded from this snapshot's candidate list as a result — not a captaincy contender either way, but the underlying names table has a resolvable ambiguity worth fixing.
